svg.aria-description: Parcelpoint on Kubernetes: 7 nodes, 6 connections. 3 workloads and 4 objects around them, imported from Kubernetes manifests. Traffic flows from each Ingress to the pods behind its Services, and dashed arrows are configuration the pods read.
svg.font-family: pw-sans-31fbcplfrh, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: Parcelpoint on Kubernetes
svg.desc: Parcelpoint on Kubernetes: 7 nodes, 6 connections. 3 workloads and 4 objects around them, imported from Kubernetes manifests. Traffic flows from each Ingress to the pods behind its Services, and dashed arrows are configuration the pods read. Nodes: - tracking (Ingress, api.parcelpoint.example), gateway - tracking-api (Deployment, 2 replicas, port 80), service - event-worker (Deployment), service - postgres (StatefulSet), database - postgres-data (PersistentVolumeClaim, 20Gi), storage - tracking-config (ConfigMap), storage - tracking-db (Secret), secret Connections: - tracking to tracking-api: api.parcelpoint.example - tracking-api to tracking-config (dashed): reads - tracking-api to tracking-db (dashed, identity line): reads - event-worker to tracking-config (dashed): reads - event-worker to tracking-db (dashed, identity line): reads - postgres to postgres-data (stored data line): mounts
